name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery bulk ordering, artwork review, and WooCommerce My Account experience.
changelog:
1.2.0

  • Rebuilds WooCommerce My Account into a responsive All Star customer experience while preserving the native WooCommerce shortcode, endpoints, authentication, orders, addresses, payment methods, downloads, account settings, and third-party account links.
  • Adds a dedicated Artwork hub with Artwork Needed, Awaiting Review, Changes Requested, and Approved states, plus artwork status and direct artwork actions in Orders.
  • Redesigns customer order artwork and the WooCommerce admin Artwork Review panel in the Style-B card-based direction with All Star navy, restrained warm gold, clearer hierarchy, file cards, review timeline, and responsive layouts.
  • Hardens Approve Artwork and Request Changes persistence by saving order meta, saving the WooCommerce order, clearing caches, reloading, and verifying the stored status before reporting success or emailing the customer.
  • No Supplier Sync pricing, WooCommerce Regular Price rules, ASBO bulk-discount tiers, cart pricing, savings, shipping, checkout, artwork file storage, or automatic stitch-count charging changed.
